_standard: ACTIVE: a usable desktop browser you can download today (no waitlists), with a release in roughly the last 12 months, AND people actually use or discuss it today: major vendor, or 1k+ GitHub stars, or covered by several current (2026) roundups. A Wikipedia article alone is NOT enough.
OUTDATED = OUT: last release >12 months ago, or a legacy/hobbyist browser nobody picks today even if technically maintained (Konqueror, Otter, Dillo, NetSurf, suckless-style WebKit shells).
DEAD: only household names or recent high-profile shutdowns (rip tag).
OUT: Chinese browsers; OS-specific ports; engine experiments without a usable browser; antivirus/vendor rebrands of Chromium; tiny forks of forks.
EXCEPTION: meme browsers the community actually knows (Pissandshittium).
